routines.name: Weekly reruns
routines.prompt: Pull, pick, draft angles and render from instructions.md.

routines.name: Stale review nudge
routines.prompt: Run python3 rerun_picker.py nudge from the Rerun Picker folder. If the review is stale_review_days old and no rejects are synced, it prints one nudge and writes picks/nudge.json. It never builds a new picks file. $0, no X calls. This routine is installed at setup. Do not wait for the owner to ask for it.

routines.name: Update check
routines.prompt: Run the once-a-day update check from the Update notice section of instructions.md. Never download without the owner's yes.

_note: Foreman fills the {placeholders} from the owner's answers before creating the routine.
